title: Subterranean Mineral Deposit Extraction
description: You are given a 2D grid matrix of integer values representing mineral density at various subterranean coordinates, where 0 represents solid rock and any positive integer represents the value of a mineral deposit. You want to find the maximum possible total value of a single contiguous mineral deposit. A deposit is formed by connecting adjacent positive values horizontally or vertically.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum sum of a connected component of positive values.

examples.explanation: The largest contiguous island of 1s has an area of 9.
There are no positive values, so the max area is 0.
All cells form a single square of 4 elements.
